limit: Documentation/source review only; no current host runtime or installed driver version is inferred.

nv_smi.reviewed_definition: The full -q query reports supported GPU fields, including Fabric handshake state/status; unsupported fields may be N/A. topo -m reports GPU/NIC topology and PCIe/NVLink connections. grep -i -A2 Fabric selects matching headings plus two lines, which can omit later Fabric fields; it is a partial inspection, not a full health verdict. Output format can vary with driver.

fabric.locator: Service management L335-355; service file L378-380; introduction L80-117
fabric.quote:
sudo systemctl status nvidia-fabricmanager
sudo journalctl -u nvidia-fabricmanager
fabric.reviewed_definition: NVIDIA directs Host-side service status and journal inspection for Fabric Manager. The applicable NVSwitch platform determines whether its service launches FM and NVLSM. Container workload output does not directly inspect the host service manager; use authorized host access. This does not establish which service variant is installed on any reviewed host.

nccl.version: archived NCCL manual page title2.27.5, archive path2276
nccl.locator: GPU Direct L28-43; topology L85-98; errors L11-19
nccl.quote: NCCL heavily relies on GPU Direct for inter-GPU communication.
nccl.reviewed_definition: NVIDIA recommends inspecting the original NCCL error and GPU-to-GPU communication; PCI configuration, container topology visibility and shared-resource limits can cause problems. This supports investigating peer communication/topology and software compatibility, not identifying a particular failed component or installed NCCL version.

journalctl.quote: relative times may be specified, prefixed with "-" or "+"
journalctl.reviewed_definition: Unit filter selects that service; --since "-24h" selects retained entries newer than24hours ago. Visibility depends on privileges and retention; this is not a guarantee24hours of logs exist.
